title: [meal-audit] Meal-prawn-ham-01 ground truth is a stub (0 g, 1 of 2 dishes, no photo) yet fanned out into 13 nutrient-drift cards

defect.observed: expected.json and meal_result.json for Meal-prawn-ham-01 are internally impossible: estimatedWeightGrams=0 while calories=13.2 (kcal per gram = Infinity), expectedDishCount=1 while the title names two items, photos/ is empty, and comparison.json's own verdict is DIVERGED with primaryCode=turn_mismatch (expected dishCount 1, actual 2). The loop filed 13 nutrient-drift cards (#22-#34) from that DIVERGED comparison even though its dispatch guard had already refused with 'ground truth incomplete for a core nutrient'. Those 13 sit state=packed queue=ready, so a dispatch would send an agent to make the Nutrient Compiler match a 0 g / 13.2 kcal stub.
defect.expected: No nutrient-drift card is filed from a comparison whose primaryCode is turn_mismatch or whose ground truth is degenerate; a comparison is refused as ungrounded BEFORE any card is created, and the refusal names the missing field. A ground truth with weight 0 and non-zero energy fails its own consistency check.
defect.criteria: node scripts/assert-meal-audit-ground-truth.mjs exits 0: it loads every artifacts/meal_audits/*/expected.json, refuses any whose declared weight is 0 while any energy or macro is non-zero, refuses any whose expectedItems count disagrees with its own title/expectedDishCount, and asserts scripts/meal-audit-loop.mjs files no card when the verdict is DIVERGED with primaryCode=turn_mismatch
